## Requires human approval

Yes — this recommendation must be reviewed and approved by a maintainer before
any workflow or code change is made. Agents in this repository never merge,
push, or modify production workflows without explicit human sign-off.

## Checklist for reviewer

- [ ] I have reviewed the underlying data/telemetry referenced above.
- [ ] I agree (or disagree, with reasoning) with the recommendation.
- [ ] I have applied (or explicitly rejected) the proposed change.
